tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Warm paper: the page background behind cards; also the web app's meta theme-color and the splash screen.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and sheet background, always on surface, outlined with hairline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Night ink: headings and primary text on card or surface (15.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions and captions on card (6.7:1) or surface (6.0:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Sunset violet, the action color: solid buttons, selected chips and tabs, links, the default avatar, the money balance card. White on it is 6.6:1; on surface it is 5.9:1.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Pale violet: tonal pill buttons, step circles, selected tiles, tips.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Violet text and icons on primary-tint (7.4:1) or card (8.9:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Yallist orange: the logo, the app icon, done checks, progress, and Graphics only on light grounds (3.1:1 on card); never text or a button fill.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Orange text on card (5.9:1) or surface (5.3:1): ‘you’re bringing this’, errors, delete.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Tracks: the switch when off, progress, the sheet grabber.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The 1px outline of a card, an unselected chip or a round button on surface.

tokens.name: accent-1
tokens.usage: Category accents 1–6, cycling over a list's category cards: the dot by the name and the items' icons. Each is at least 4.3:1 on card.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, at the start edge of the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: פותחים טיול, שולחים קישור לחברים, ובוחרים ביחד מי מביא מה.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Titles of list rows and steps, in ink.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Second line under an item-title, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The small heading of a group of rows, in ink-muted.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: Numerals inside step circles, primary on primary-tint.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Countdowns and stat values; tabular digits so counts don't shift.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an item-title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a section-title and its body text inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards; header to first card; step circle to its text; icon to label in the floating button.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; tonal button inline padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between step rows; floating button inline padding and its gap from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the single content column on web and tablets.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, and the top corners of an illustration that opens a card.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile when drawn in the UI. Store icons ship full-bleed; the OS masks the corners.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Header avatar; also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: size-spot
tokens.usage: A 4:3 crop of a scene, or a state spot.

tokens.name: avatar-xs
tokens.usage: Avatar sizes: xs 24, sm 28 (stacks), md 32, lg 44, xl 56, xxl 96 (profile).

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Rings and bars. Graphics only: the count is always shown beside them (brand on line is 2.1:1).

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Ring and bar track; visible at 0%.

tokens.name: is-rtl
tokens.usage: The app is Hebrew-only; code reads this constant, never I18nManager.isRTL (false on react-native-web).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only what floats: the floating primary button and the toast. Cards stay flat, with a hairline.
